intro: The fiancé visa lets you come to the UK to marry, or register a civil partnership with, your British or settled partner within 6 months. You then switch to a spouse visa without leaving the UK.
cardText: For couples marrying in the UK within 6 months of arriving.

checklist.hint: With evidence such as a booking

checklist.item: Your partner is British or settled

purposes.title: Switch to a spouse visa
purposes.text: From inside the UK, before the 6 months end.

notCovered: You can’t work while on the fiancé visa
It can’t be extended beyond 6 months, except in limited cases
You must marry within the 6 months

documentsTable.details: Both partners’ current and previous passports.
Evidence of your wedding or ceremony plans, such as a booking.
Payslips, bank statements and employer letters, or savings evidence, in the exact format the rules require.
From an approved provider at the required level, unless exempt.
Tenancy agreement or property documents, and permission from the owner if needed.

rules.title: Marry within 6 months
rules.text: You must marry or register your civil partnership within the 6 months, then apply for a [spouse visa](/spouse-visa-application/) before the fiancé visa expires.

rules.title: The financial requirement
rules.text: Most new applications need £29,000 a year from income, savings or both. Some sponsors who receive certain benefits are exempt. [Read our financial requirement guide](/spouse-visa-financial-requirement/)

rules.title: English language
rules.text: A1 for a first application, A2 when you extend, and B1 for settlement, unless you are exempt. [Read our English language guide](/english-language-requirement/)

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: Fiancé visa requirements
sections.text: You must both be 18 or over, have met in person, intend to marry or register a civil partnership in the UK within 6 months and live together permanently, and meet the financial, English language and accommodation requirements. Proposed civil partners use the same route.

sections.heading: After your wedding
sections.text: Once you’re married, you apply to switch to a spouse visa from inside the UK, which usually gives you 2 years 6 months.

faqs.q: Can I work on a fiancé visa?
faqs.a: No. You can work once you switch to a spouse visa.

faqs.q: How long is a fiancé visa?
Is the fiancé visa the right choice if we can marry abroad?
faqs.a: Not always. Marrying first and applying for a spouse visa can be simpler and cheaper. We’ll compare the options.
